name: Kingrinder P0
details: Hand grinder with internal adjustment: 30 clicks per rotation, about 33.33 µm per click, counted from zero. 38 mm stainless steel burr.

grindRanges.scale: clicks from zero (adjustment turned until the burrs touch)

notes.turkish: Kingrinder's chart gives no extra-fine (Turkish) setting for the P0.
notes.espresso: Kingrinder's chart gives no fine (espresso) setting for the P0.
notes.moka: Kingrinder groups moka pot and AeroPress (medium-fine).
notes.aeropress: Kingrinder groups moka pot and AeroPress (medium-fine).

rangeInfo.note: Kingrinder's “Grind Setting Chart of KINGrinder (Clicks)” on its site, P0 column: medium-fine 30–40, medium 45–60, coarse 70–80. Kingrinder's chart is by grind size, not brew method; mapped as their K4/K6 manual pairs them (extra fine → Turkish, fine → espresso, medium-fine → moka pot/AeroPress, medium → pour-over, coarse → French press). Same page: 30 clicks per round, 33.33 µm per click.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range; drip coffee maker: the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser. Dial in from there.
